column1: # Bauhaus stores, read from the brand's own store finder on 2026-09-29.
# robots.txt permits the page and an ordinary HTTP client is answered 200; what is refused
# is this service's Go client, which Cloudflare scores on its TLS fingerprint rather than
# on the name it gives. Making that client imitate a browser is the one thing not to do, so
# the nine shops are written down here instead. The page's shape, for the day the fetcher
# can reach it: div.storelistitem with data-store-id, data-store-lat and data-store-lng, a
# storetitle, a storeaddress ending "District - Province", and a tel: link.
